answer: A village meadow co-op used to let one badge open every seed locker. A grower may now book only one night slot: they lodge 37 units, press a numbered copper wafer into the latch, and radio a 12-second tone that must match a listed nebula catalog frequency for that hour. Two stewards play back the recording against the catalog and weigh the wafer; credit is released at dawn only when both the tone and the wafer hash are new. A repeated pitch or a wafer already weighed is melted, and the 37 units remain in the locker, so cloned keys buy scrap metal in place of more locker claims.
